capabilities: Create typed campaign entities (NPCs, quests, locations) from commands and slash commands
Track combat with an initiative tracker for HP, conditions, and turn order
Run live sessions in a three-panel layout with quick inserts and logging
Reveal an interactive campaign map with fog of war and labeled pins
Render 5e monster statblocks and roll dice inline in notes
extras: Manual installation (copy files into .obsidian/plugins); a hosted companion service (campaign-scribe) is announced for a future v0.6; canvas-based views are noted as weak on small phone screens.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for planning and running tabletop RPG campaigns, so game masters must assemble many single-purpose plugins and external apps themselves.

relations.evidence: Templater | Powers entity creation from templates.
Dataview | Enables advanced queries in your notes
Importing from D&D Beyond: - Click Import from DDB in the PC Sheet view
paste the character's JSON export from the Beyond20 browser extension instead
interoperate cleanly with a future hosted memory service (campaign-scribe, planned for v0.6)

summary: Campaign management toolkit for D&D 5e with typed entity creation, a session runner, initiative tracker, fog-of-war map, and dice rolling in Obsidian.
